## Change type

Tick one primary type. `type: breaking` is additional and may accompany another type.

- [ ] `type: feature` — new capability within the existing architecture
- [ ] `type: problem` — correction of defective behavior or clarification of a boundary
- [ ] `type: internal` — refactor, dependency, CI, or internal cleanup without user-visible change
- [ ] `type: design` — visual language, interaction patterns, or design principles without functional change
- [ ] `type: breaking` — incompatible change (combine with the primary type above)
